note: How each raw image in art/raw/ is cut. Cells are listed row by row; null skips a cell. size is the target in game pixels. full: the cell is a whole tile with no background. stretch: fill the target exactly instead of keeping the shape. The art style guide's file table is not in the repository yet, so the lab wrote this from the images themselves. pixel: the sheet is true pixel art at game size, cut pixel for pixel with no shrink; anchor (bottom or center) places an item in its picture; box [x, y, w, h] cuts a cell by hand; pad_left adds clear columns on the left so a door lines up.
